**🕒 Trigger (Every 20 mins)**
Starts the workflow automatically at fixed intervals.

**⚙️ Run Server Script**

- Checks server health

- Verifies daily / weekly / monthly backups

**📊 Combine Results**
- Collects & merges output from all servers into one dataset.

**🧹 Filter + Format**
- Cleans data → Builds a readable table for alerts.

**💬 Slack Alerts**
- Sends formatted notifications via our Slack App to the team.

## Every 20 mins Alerts AI Agents
- **CPU usage** 
- **RAM usage**
- **Disk Usage**
- **Daily/weekly/monthly backup reports**
